text: ma. yu. pāde . 2 ma. yu. sāvatthiyaṃ . divā vihārāyāti . evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā rāhulo bhagavato paṭissutvā nisīdanaṃ ādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi . tena kho pana samayena anekāni devatāsahassāni bhagavantaṃ anubandhāni bhavanti ajja bhagavā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ uttariṃ āsavānaṃ khaye vinessatīti . [188] atha kho bhagavā andhavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle paññatte āsane nisīdi . āyasmāpi kho rāhulo bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi . ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
